name: 48363 · Oakland, MI
findings: ZIP 48363 (Oakland) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48363 (Oakland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48363 (Oakland) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
